channel.title: Business Today India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Today India (businesstoday.in)

item.title: Sensex, Nifty open higher on India-US trade deal impact, positive global cues
item.description: Sensex rose 400 points to 83,980 and Nifty gained 117 points to 25,811. Of 30 Sensex stocks, 19 were trading in the green.

item.title: 'Delhi will become Khalistan': Nine schools get bomb threat emails, evacuations spark citywide alert
item.description: Delhi Police was alerted, and fire teams along with bomb disposal squads were immediately deployed. Students and staff were evacuated from the premises as a precaution

item.title: Apple CarPlay to get third party AI voice chat bots ending Siri exclusivity
item.description: CarPlay has restricted voice-activated commands and assistance solely to Apple’s own digital assistant, Siri. However, under the new plans, rival AI services from companies such as OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic will soon be accessible to drivers.

item.title: ‘World doesn’t want us to produce, only to be a market’: Vedanta’s Anil Agarwal says India must push back
item.description: "We must fight to be self-sufficient. After all, this is a country which used to be import dependent on food. And then became self-sufficient," said Anil Agarwal.

item.title: YES Bank shares snap two-day fall; analysts advise caution on near-term outlook
item.description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has recently approved the appointment of Vinay Muralidhar Tonse as the new Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of the Mumbai-based private sector bank.

item.title: Tata Steel shares hit record high on Q3 earnings; here's what brokerages say
item.description: Tata Steel stock gained 3% to hit a high of Rs 203 in early deals against the previous close of Rs 197.05.

item.title: HbA1c-only diagnosis may misclassify diabetes in India, Lancet warns
item.description: Accuracy can be affected in populations with high levels of anaemia, inherited blood disorders, G6PD deficiency.

item.title: Suzlon Energy price target cut by 33%, order inflows at risk; here's why
item.description: Suzlon Energy shares are already down over 9% this year and have fallen 25% in six months.

item.title: How India’s IT sector is facing up to the AI threat

item.title: Exclusive: Adani Group to start coal gasification work this year, expand MRO operations, says Jeet Adani
item.description: On aircraft manufacturing, Jeet Adani told Business Today that a final decision would be taken after consultations with its global partner.
